title: Bride of Christ
definition: The Bride of Christ is a biblical picture of the Church as loved, cleansed, cherished, and prepared for union with Christ.
summary: The Bride of Christ reveals the Church as the beloved people Christ purifies, cherishes, and prepares for Himself.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the Bridegroom who gave Himself to make His people holy and beautiful before God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine highlights covenant love, holiness, beauty, and future glory. The Church is loved by Christ with sacrificial devotion and is being prepared for the wedding day of the Lamb. It gives a deeply personal picture of Christ's affection for His people.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because believers may see the Church only through its weaknesses and wounds. The bride image does not deny present imperfections; it shows Christ's purpose to cleanse and present His people in splendor. It calls the Church to faithful love and holy readiness.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: View the Church through Christ's redeeming love without excusing sin. Pursue purity, faithfulness, and readiness for the Bridegroom. Let this doctrine soften contempt toward the Church and strengthen hope for her final glory.
